barRaise.reconcileNote:
Close leg, run first. Every one of the nineteen carried openFindings ids was matched against both the live queue and the archive, filtered to items tagged for this project and dated at or after the finding's first sighting. Ten came back closed, and every one of those ten carried a COMPLETELY EMPTY notes field and an empty title, so not one of them could be closed on its own record. All ten were re-verified against the code by a separate read-only pass and all ten hold: `architecture-02`, `architecture-04`, `compliance-data-steward-04`, `-05`, `-06`, `finance-product-categorization-tail-05`, `finance-product-dedupe-03`, `finance-product-threat-model-01` and `-02`, plus `finance-product-threat-model-04`, which the threat-model lens found closed by the first-launch consent modal after 15 runs open. That an entire batch of closures carried no evidence is itself worth fixing; the queue writer does not require a closure note and nothing checks for one.

`observability-03` was reported closed by nothing and is re-filed this run as `observability-01` with fresh evidence: the audit-findings self-test still is not invoked by preship, by the release script, or by the security workflow. `release-pipeline-gate-page-publish-05` stays open and moves to the deferred list rather than being reported clean, because its subject lives in another project's folder and a single-project run cannot see it, which is the same reason the previous run gave. The seven orchestration findings are carried unverified and are marked as such in the action list.
barRaise.verdictNote: Health 71 sits in the in-progress band. The verdict is one step below it on a breakage signal, not on the number: reliability-01 is live, silent, unrecoverable loss of real bank transactions on an install carrying real money.
